full_judgment: Sharif Uddin Chaklader J : This Rule by the third party who sought to be added as co-plaintiff in Title Suit No. 175 of 2007 filed by the plaintiff-opposite parties for a decree for declaration of title in respect of 'ga' schedule property for correction of RS khatian in respect of 'Gha' schedule property while the suit was at preemptory hearing stage. The petitioner sought to be added as co-plaintiff in the suit on the ground that they purchased the suit land from the plaintiffs by registered deed dated 28-7-2008 and 15-6-2004 and they have mutated their names and opened separate city corporation holding, paying tax, electricity bills, gas bills, WASA bills regularly.
